headlineFinding_mirrorChannelVsReadback.question: Does anything establish an executed READ-BACK from a RENDER / PERSIST / EXPORT store?
headlineFinding_mirrorChannelVsReadback.answer: NO. Neither mirror gate performs an executed read from a render, persistence or export store. mirror-completeness proves a channel is DECLARED. mirror-reachability executes the EMIT half only; its LISTEN half is a regex over source text.

check-mirror-completeness.whatItDoesEstablish: It is a STATIC set-difference. It parses handler files for `affectedStores`, resolves which bus verbs write a plugin DTO store, and asks whether each such verb has a matching `case` arm in packages/runtime-composer/src/CommandEventBridge.ts (2256 lines). A verb with a case arm is COVERED; one without goes on mirror-debt.json. Nothing is executed. Nothing is read back.
check-mirror-completeness.whatItDoesNotEstablish_gatesOwnWords: [mirror-completeness] NOT ESTABLISHED HERE: that any covered verb's event reaches a subscriber, a legacy record, or a mesh.  ·  A bridge case is a DECLARED channel. C16 §5.1 CA-21 wants an executed read-back.
check-mirror-completeness.printedSubject: 1407 handler file(s) · 361 verb(s) · 28 plugin DTO store key(s) from 35 store file(s) · 38 bridge case arm(s) + 8 mutation-table verb(s)
check-mirror-completeness.printedResult: 200 verbs write a plugin DTO store - 44 with a bridge case, 156 WITHOUT. Ledger 156 rows: 109 kind=UNMIRRORED ('these will not update on screen'), 47 declared-exempt.
check-mirror-completeness.theAsymmetryItNames: grep -c "\.created'" apps/editor/src/engine/initTools.ts -> 17;  grep -c "\.updated'" -> 0. Gate header: 'Every element family can be CREATED and reach the render layer. None can be UPDATED and reach it.' Its own run prints the current census as 19 '*.created' mirrors and 1 '*.updated' mirror.

check-mirror-reachability.whatItDoesEstablish: The EMIT half, genuinely executed. It constructs a real CommandBus, loads real plugin handler classes, dispatches 14 named verbs across 3 families through the real CommandEventBridge, counts forward patches, and records which typed events actually fired. Five executed controls (negative, positive, refusal, orphan-channel, and an explode-vs-refuse discriminator) fire on every run, so the instrument is watched failing.
check-mirror-reachability.whatItDoesNotEstablish: The LISTEN half is a NAME MATCH, not an execution. Nothing is read back from any store.
check-mirror-reachability.theMechanism_source: tools/ga-gate/check-mirror-reachability.ts:227 function subscriberCensus() - const RE = /\.on\(\s*'([a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9._-]*\.[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+)'/g; walks SUBSCRIBER_ROOTS reading file text and recording which files CONTAIN a matching listener registration. A file containing the string is scored as a subscriber.
check-mirror-reachability.gatesOwnWords_header: tools/ga-gate/check-mirror-reachability.ts:101-107 §WHAT-THIS-DOES-NOT-COVER - '1. The subscriber is NAMED, not RUN. apps/editor/src/engine/initTools.ts imports the browser world (its transitive svg2pdf.js import alone refuses to load under node), so no gate in this directory can execute a mirror callback. A REACHES-SUBSCRIBER verdict means "a typed event really fired, and a file really contains a listener for that name" - the emit half is executed, the listen half is a grep.'
check-mirror-reachability.gatesOwnWords_terminal: [mirror-reachability] WHAT THIS GREEN DOES NOT SAY - the EMIT half is executed, the LISTEN half is a NAME MATCH.  ·  Not covered: that the subscriber RUNS, that the legacy record is well-formed, that a mesh appears, that the serializer carries it, or anything at all about the 337+ verbs outside this named set.
explicitlyUncovered_perSource: 2. The legacy RECORD is not inspected - whether the subscriber writes a WELL-FORMED legacy record (the boundaryLine defect) is invisible.
3. No mesh. LiftCompoundReachesTheMesh.test.ts / BeamMasterMaterialReachesMesh.test.ts are per-family vitest suites, not a gate.
4. The SERIALIZER is not checked. boundaryLine's zero occurrences in either ProjectSerializer is still nobody's gate.
5. App-registered BridgeSpec verbs (element.changeType) are INVISIBLE - initBusHandlers.ts cannot load outside a browser.
check-mirror-reachability.acknowledgedUnsafeDirection: Source comment at check-mirror-reachability.ts:217-226: the regex 'also matches DOM and Node emitters using the same spelling. That over-counts in the SAFE direction for an orphan census ... and in the UNSAFE direction for a REACHES-SUBSCRIBER verdict.' So the 7 REACHES-SUBSCRIBER readings are the gate's own least-safe output.
check-mirror-reachability.executedReadFromRenderPersistExport: NONE. Confirmed by source read: the only executed side is bus dispatch + patch counting. No renderer, no persistence-client, no exporter is instantiated or queried.

eslintResolverGap.question: Does the import/resolver gap that made eslint-plugin-boundaries blind to @pryzm/* specifiers still exist?
eslintResolverGap.answer: YES, the gap still exists - but it is now a DOCUMENTED DELIBERATE NON-CHOICE, not an accident. There is no import/resolver key in eslint.config.js; the only four matches (lines 402, 404, 410, 412) are inside a comment block explaining its absence.
eslintResolverGap.settingsBlock: eslint.config.js:397-419 - settings: { 'boundaries/elements': layerElements, 'boundaries/include': ['packages/**','tools/**','apps/**','plugins/**'] } and NO resolver.
eslintResolverGap.quotedComment: §FIX-LAYER-GATE-BLIND (L-809) - READ THIS BEFORE TRUSTING THE RULE BELOW. There is NO `import/resolver` configured here, and adding one is a deliberate NON-CHOICE. eslint-plugin-boundaries classifies a file by its RESOLVED PATH, so without a resolver it cannot map `@pryzm/geometry-wall` to `packages/geometry-wall/**` - and in this monorepo essentially every cross-package import is written that way. **The `boundaries/element-types` rule below therefore only sees RELATIVE imports.** That is still worth having, but it is not the layer gate. ... THE AUTHORITY FOR THE LAYER RULE IS `tools/ga-gate/check-layer-boundaries.ts`.
eslintResolverGap.packageEvidence: grep -n 'eslint-import-resolver' package.json -> no match. ls node_modules | grep -i 'import-resolver' -> no match. No resolver package is installed, consistent with the documented refusal.
eslintResolverGap.verdict: The CLAUDE.md claim that check-layer-boundaries.ts is THE authority is CONFIRMED by the config file itself. The eslint rule remains blind to @pryzm/* and is retained only for relative-path violations.
